description: Incident handling capability is not implemented for preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing incident handling procedures, absence of incident detection mechanisms, lack of containment and eradication processes, and missing recovery procedures.
